calls.video_title: Is Chewy Stock a Buy Right Now in November 2026? | CHWY Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: BUY — reiterated (was BUY 30 Oct). 'I will be reiterating my buy ranking for Chewy today.' Forward P/E 12, about one-third of expected EPS growth (PEG ~1/3); DCF $36 vs ~$23, ~58% undervalued; self-funding growth, no need for new capital.
calls.base_case: Management targets double-digit revenue growth: low-to-mid single-digit new customers plus near-double-digit spend growth per customer; Wall Street expects 31%+ EPS growth.
calls.bull_case: Nearly 80% of sales from autoship recurring orders; operating margin improved from -16% (2019) to ~2.75%.
calls.bear_case: Every investment carries risk; growth depends on sustaining customer-spend gains — no specific bear case quantified in the video.

calls.price_at_call: Fair value $33; market price garbled in captions (~53% upside over 12-18 months)

calls.bull_case: Steady execution and logistics gains compound.
